responsibility: Supplies assembler-facing register names, token-gluing helpers, function-entry/exit macros, and optional CFI directives for PowerPC assembly sources used with GCC. Its core responsibility is to hide ABI differences between ELFv2, ELFv1/.opd, AIX descriptor, and plain 32-bit conventions by providing FUNC_START/FUNC_END, hidden-function, TOC, jump-target, and unwind directive macros that assembly code and runtime support files can use portably across rs6000 environments.
